review_evidence: README identifies the project as a Lean formalization of Erdős Problem #870 on additive bases with many representations and no minimal subbasis.
10 of 11 Lean files contain theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations, including substantial probability-measure and Bernoulli-coordinate infrastructure.
Representative results include existence from almost-everywhere events, measure-realization pullback lemmas, and Bernoulli probability-measure facts used by the main argument.
summary: Reviewed erdos-870; retain the formalization of Erdős problem 870 and its probability/additive-combinatorics infrastructure.
